erin: US-WEST2 tiny-gang backlog: lots of tiny pods pinned to older racks, eviction churn up.
ben: noticed. Label migration to `rack:stable` yesterday pinned many tiny jobs. Combined with warmnode handoff lag it's creating micro-silos.
clair: Warmnode attach p95 jumped from 500ms -> 4s in us-west2c. Logs show spike in conntrack GC and node egress NAT throttling.
erin: That's probably why latebind waits are long and pods pile on same racks.
ops-bot: Alert: us-west2c_pod_eviction_rate 0.9% (15m)
ben: Quick mitigation idea: enable a targeted relaxer that allows pods with annotation `infra/binpack=relax` to ignore rack affinity for 45m. Scope to tiny-gang only.
clair: Also reduce warmnode attach timeout to 9s to clear the attach queue. Risk: coldstart latency could increase slightly.
erin: I'll patch scheduler-configmap and run a single-AZ canary in us-west2c. Command: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"allow_binpack_relax":"true","relax_ttl":"45m","attach_timeout":"9s"}}'`
ops-bot: Runbook check passed. Oncall signoff required.
ben: Oncall approved. Starting canary now.
ops-bot: Canary deployed by erin at 1769876555. Monitoring p99 latency and eviction-rate.
erin: 8m update: p99 scheduler latency down from 1.5s -> 0.8s, evictions from 0.9% -> 0.2%. Egress delta estimate +1.6%.
clair: Good signal. Keep canary for 30m and then either promote cluster-wide or revert. Create follow-up ticket to gate label-rollout on warmpool saturation.
ops-bot: Ticket created: SCHED-4855 by clair
